fields.FIR_Description: During the night of 2026-05-07, around 01:45, the complainant reported that a maroon auto bearing registration number TN-68-ZZ-1032 was missing from the stand near Vaigai Park Parking Area, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-05-07. Rajesh Mani submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000409. A witness, Madhan Murugan, reachable on 9000000216, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Bharath Balan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000047. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away after being left unattended.
fields.Keywords: auto theft, vehicle, night, mobile number, parking area, auto, witness, suspect
